return-target-page.no-lines: No goods are expected back: the order was cancelled before dispatch.
return-target-page.opened-by-staff: Our team, on the buyer's request

return-staff-actions.hint-close: Use this when the refund was canceled or the money went back outside the app. Nothing is paid, restocked or emailed.
return-staff-actions.error-note-too-long: The note is too long ({max} characters at most)
return-staff-actions.hint-cancel: Use this when the goods will never come back. Nothing is paid, restocked or emailed, and the same items can be returned again. If the buyer posted the parcel and it got lost, receive it with a restock count of 0 instead.
return-staff-actions.label-deduction: Handling damage to keep back ({currency}, optional)
return-staff-actions.error-reason-too-long: The reason is too long ({max} characters at most)
return-staff-actions.error-deduction-invalid: Enter zero or a positive amount
return-staff-actions.success-receive: Goods received and the customer paid back.
return-staff-actions.hint-remedy: The buyer's choice is preselected. You may give another when theirs is impossible or disproportionate. A repair or replacement moves no money and closes the return.
return-staff-actions.success-receive-remedy: Goods received. The return is closed and no money moved.
return-staff-actions.label-restock: Units to put back on sale
return-staff-actions.hint-restock: Set a line to 0 for a broken unit: it never reaches the shelf. The refund does not change.
return-staff-actions.error-restock-invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 up to the line's quantity
return-staff-actions.hint-message: Optional. Required for "Other": the buyer reads it beside the reason.
return-staff-actions.error-message-required: Write a message to the buyer: "Other" alone does not say why.

returns-request.remedy-notice: For a faulty or wrong item you choose: a repair, a replacement or your money back. Choosing a repair extends your guarantee by 12 months.
returns-request.hint-note: Describe the item. Don't include phone numbers or addresses.
returns-request.error-note-too-long: The note is too long ({max} characters at most)
returns-request.error-lines-required: Pick at least one item to send back
returns-request.hint-line-excluded: Made to order goods can only come back if they are defective or not what you ordered.
returns-request.error-quantity-invalid: Enter a whole quantity, from 1 up to what you can still return
returns-request.success: Return requested. We will review it and email you.
returns-request.button-open-staff: Open a return for the buyer
returns-request.hint-exception: This reason is past its deadline. The return will be opened anyway and recorded as an exception.
returns-request.error-date-invalid: Enter a day that is not in the future

withdrawal-panel.title: Returns and withdrawal
withdrawal-panel.until: You may withdraw from this contract until the end of {date}.
withdrawal-panel.until-delivery: You may withdraw from this contract. The withdrawal period starts when the goods are delivered.
withdrawal-panel.confirm: Withdraw from order {id}? You will receive a written confirmation with the date and time.
withdrawal-panel.success: Withdrawal received. A confirmation is on its way to your email.
withdrawal-panel.cancel-hint: Your withdrawal period starts when the last shipment arrives.
withdrawal-panel.blocked-all_excluded: Everything in this order was made to your specifications, so the right of withdrawal does not apply. If nothing has shipped, you can still cancel the order.
withdrawal-panel.blocked-window_closed: The withdrawal period for this order has ended.
withdrawal-panel.blocked-nothing_left: Everything in this order has already been returned.
withdrawal-panel.record-hint: The buyer withdrew by phone, email or letter? Record it with the day they sent it.

cancel-remainder-dialog.title: Cancel what has not shipped: group #{number}
cancel-remainder-dialog.lead: These items have not left yet and will not be sent:
cancel-remainder-dialog.success: Cancelled. The refund is on its way.
cancel-remainder-dialog.label-as-withdrawal: This is the buyer's withdrawal, stated outside the shop

stated-at-fields.hint-date: Leave empty for now. The deadline is judged on this day.

record-withdrawal-dialog.title: Record a withdrawal
record-withdrawal-dialog.lead: The law counts a withdrawal from the day the buyer sent it, not the day you read it. The buyer is emailed both days. You will be asked for your password: this is a legal record.
record-withdrawal-dialog.error-date-invalid: Enter the day the buyer sent it, not in the future
record-withdrawal-dialog.error-channel-required: Choose how the buyer sent it
record-withdrawal-dialog.success: Withdrawal recorded. The buyer is emailed the day they stated it.
